summary: AMD filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $5.0 billion five-year unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing a prior 2022 credit agreement. The facility is for general corporate purposes, with no borrowings outstanding at closing. Interest is based on Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a credit ratings-based margin, with customary commitment fees. Borrowings may be repaid and reborrowed before the fifth anniversary. This is a routine refinancing of a credit line, not a special situation event.
